settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Control per client which Slack notifications are sent. The switches take effect immediately — while a switch is off, no corresponding Slack messages go out for that client.
settings.noClients: You currently have no client assigned.

billingMode.label: Billing model
billingMode.description: Prepaid = lower hourly rate, prepaid top-ups. Monthly billing = higher hourly rate, monthly billing based on effort. Only administrators can change this model.

jiraWarnings.label: Jira threshold warnings
jiraWarnings.description: When a Jira ticket exceeds a configured threshold, a Slack message is sent to the client's channel. When switched off here, the channel stays silent for these warnings.

weeklyReport.label: Weekly report
weeklyReport.description: Weekly summary per client Slack channel. Switching it off suppresses the next and all further weekly reports for this client, until the switch is enabled again.

language.label: Project language
language.description: Language of the client-facing Slack messages (weekly report, Jira warnings, work stop) for this client.

mediumName.label: Medium name
mediumName.description: Terraform identifier that maps this client to its uptime monitor. Set during onboarding.
mediumName.hint: Terraform identifier: lowercase letters, digits, underscores.

warning.title: Only change this if you're sure
warning.body: The value must exactly match the medium name in the infrastructure. A wrong value shows another medium's availability, or none. Leaving it empty disables monitoring for this client.

contract.label: Contract
contract.description: View this client's contracts, create new versions and upload signed contracts.

links.label: Links
links.description: Customize the dashboard's editor and website links and manage your own quick-access links.
links.overrideHelp: Leave empty to derive the URL automatically from the API URL.
links.derivedUnavailable: No API URL set – please enter a URL
links.customEmpty: No custom links yet. Add some below.

globalSettings.title: Global settings
globalSettings.subtitle: Network-wide settings for all clients. Administrators only.
globalSettings.weShareDescription: Channel ID of the network-wide #we-share channel (e.g. C0AB12CD3EF). It is linked from every client's dashboard.
